reference: Bai & Ramdas (2026), arXiv:2610.35821, Proposition 4.2(iii), Appendix C.4
interpretation: RC-eBH's expected rejection count matched the optimum of an LP containing every nonempty subset certificate constraint for all 200 random families with K<=5.
The LP and RC-eBH tails also matched to floating-point precision in these tested instances.
This is strong independent computational corroboration of the formula and a useful regression oracle.
It does not prove Proposition 4.2(iii) for arbitrary K or validate the paper's LP-duality argument in general.
scope: arbitrary dependence at the theorem level assuming marginal e-values valid
small finite K computational check only
